reason_for_selection: The change completes a distinct GIF config_decoder with metadata and frame-configuration operations. H0 instantiates only wuffs_gif__decoder, so it cannot exercise the new decoder type or its call sequence.

The commit implements CRC_DISCARD and chunk-cache discard branches. H0 hard-codes SPNG_CRC_USE for both CRC classes and fixed chunk limits, so the new configuration-dependent paths and their structured boundary cases are not exercised.

The commit introduces JSON import/export and format dispatch. H0 has separate binary and XML targets that call only plist_from_bin and plist_from_xml; neither invokes plist_from_json or supplies a JSON-specific target/corpus.

The commit adds shared-dictionary APIs whose data must be attached before decoding or encoding starts, while H0 creates a decoder state and immediately calls BrotliDecoderDecompressStream without any dictionary setup.

The commit adds a public asynchronous getaddrinfo family with hints, service handling, callback results, and dedicated reply assembly. H0 only calls reply parsers and ares_create_query, so it cannot invoke the new resolver workflow.
